Winter Break runs December 20–31. New Year's Day is January 1, and the published calendar shows students returning Monday, January 3.
This is a student half-day and half clerical day on the Friday before Spring Break. It is not part of the April 3–7 break.
This is a separate Wellness Day / Easter Monday closure, not an extension of Spring Break. Schools and central offices are closed.
The scheduled last day is also a student half-day and the end of the fourth quarter.

customSections.content: Four published dates differ in ways that may affect family planning.

definitions.description: The first published opening date moves from August 24 in 2026–27 to August 23 in 2027–28.
Spring Break moves to April 3–7, 2028, from March 29–April 2, 2027.
April 17 is a separate Wellness Day / Easter Monday closure.
The published last day is June 2, compared with June 4 in 2026–27; both dates are student half-days.

customSections.label: Confirm Your HCPS School for 2027–28
customSections.content: Henrico County Public Schools and Richmond Public Schools are separate divisions with different calendars and attendance boundaries. A mailing address that says “Richmond, VA” does not by itself identify the school division. Some attendance boundaries change for 2027–28, including the approved Quioccasin Middle School adjustment, so families affected by rezoning should confirm their assigned school with the HCPS School Locator.

calendarFaqs.q: When does HCPS begin the 2027–28 school year?
calendarFaqs.a: HCPS begins with a staggered opening on August 23–24, 2027. The published calendar lists August 23 as the first day for pre-K, kindergarten, grades 6 and 9, and August 24 as the first day for all grades.

calendarFaqs.q: How does the HCPS 2027–28 staggered opening work?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar shows two opening dates: August 23 for pre-K, kindergarten, grades 6 and 9, followed by August 24 for all grades. HCPS has not yet published separate 2027–28 school-specific opening guidance, so this page does not extend the 2026–27 pre-K and kindergarten group rules into the new school year.

calendarFaqs.q: When is HCPS Thanksgiving Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: HCPS Thanksgiving Break is Wednesday through Friday, November 24–26, 2027. Students return Monday, November 29.

calendarFaqs.q: When is HCPS Winter Break in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: HCPS Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027. New Year's Day is January 1, and students return Monday, January 3, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is HCPS Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: HCPS Spring Break runs Monday, April 3, through Friday, April 7, 2028. Students return Monday, April 10.

calendarFaqs.q: Is March 31, 2028, a full school day in HCPS?
calendarFaqs.a: No. March 31 is a student half-day and half clerical day. It falls immediately before Spring Break but is not part of the April 3–7 break.

calendarFaqs.q: Is April 17, 2028, part of HCPS Spring Break?
calendarFaqs.a: No. April 17 is a separate Wellness Day / Easter Monday closure. Schools and central offices are closed that day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for HCPS in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day is Friday, June 2, 2028. It is also a student half-day and the end of the fourth quarter.

sourceReviewSummary: Last checked August 10, 2026. We verified the dates on this page against the official HCPS 2027–28 instructional calendar and did not carry forward school-specific opening rules from 2026–27.
sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we verified the HCPS 2027–28 calendar
sourceReviewDetails: The official PDF lists August 23 as the first day for pre-K, kindergarten, grades 6 and 9, and August 24 as the first day for all grades.
HCPS's current Back to School page is labeled 2026–27, so its pre-K and kindergarten group instructions are not used as 2027–28 facts.
Winter Break is published as December 20–31. The January calendar shows January 3 as the first regular student day after the break and New Year's Day.
The PDF identifies March 31 as a student half-day, April 3–7 as Spring Break, April 17 as a separate closure, and June 2 as the student half-day and last day.
Return dates after Thanksgiving, Winter Break, and Spring Break are based on the published student calendar.
